note: SR10 allowlist (design K-D21). Final for the soak of 2026-11 (draft set to false 2026-11-27, owner rulings of 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27). A difference passes only on an entry with status accepted that matches kind, role (or *), item (exact, or a prefix when match is prefix), the attribute for a label key, the span kind for a span, and covers every missing language; status unmeasured makes the item UNMEASURED by owner ruling, only for the run ids in its runs field; proposed and needs-row never pass (--sr10-accept-proposed previews proposed). Accepted gaps of the soak, not allowlisted on purpose: AG14 (A54) Python without db.client.operation.duration; AG15 (A55) .NET db.client.operation.duration without db.namespace / db.operation.name / error.type; AG16 (A56) Go http.client.request.duration without error.type (measured in Go; Python and Node.js not measured); AG18 (A57) SQL query span names; AG19 (A58) Go HTTP client span name. needs-row: the item waits for its row in docs/site/library/overview.md (A50 pass).
